subject: Current source-only scraper result-quality and safe projection task
body:
FT-HERMES/1
CONTRACT: ACK-NACK-1
TYPE: TASK
TASK: SCRAPER-RESULT-QUALITY-CURRENT-R1
WIRE: CODEX-SCRAPER-RESULT-QUALITY-R1-TASK-001
SEQ: 1
IN_REPLY_TO: NONE
SUPERSEDES: SCRAPER-RESULT-QUALITY-COPY-R9
STATE: OPEN
TERMINAL: NO
NEXT_OWNER: HERMES
NEXT_ACTION: Verify SOURCE_REF exactly, materialize the isolated COPY_ROOT, audit the current scraper result contract, then return one correlated ACK/ACCEPTED, one evidence-bearing PROGRESS after a real source/test delta, and one terminal DELIVERY or BLOCKED.
REASON: CURRENT_SOURCE_REISSUE_AFTER_STALE_R9
SOURCE_REPO: github.com/dominator509/axiom
SOURCE_BRANCH: refs/heads/codex/telegram-webhook-hardening
SOURCE_REF: 278cfcaa83ada6053bd9f0906417bc764385f514
SOURCE_PRECHECK: The exact commit is authoritative; the branch is only a fetch transport. Never substitute the moving tip or an older R9 copy.
COPY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/codex-scraper-quality-current-r1
COPY_ROOT_RULE: Use this bridge-directory root only. Do not edit the baseline checkout or any installed/runtime path.
MISSION: Close the source-level F-17/F-18 result-quality gap without inventing a scraper provider, schema, migration or runtime claim. The current source already has bounded request validation, model/org/egress binding, worker response limits, partial/all-failed semantics and a dashboard result component. Audit the real callsites before editing.
SCOPE: packages/api/src/scraper-quality-contract.ts; packages/api/src/scraper-quality-contract.test.ts; packages/api/src/routes/scrape.ts; packages/api/src/routes/scrape.test.ts; packages/worker/src/executors/scrape.ts; packages/worker/src/executors/scrape.test.ts; packages/dashboard/components/ScrapeResult.tsx; packages/dashboard/components/ScrapeResult.test.tsx; packages/dashboard/components/ScrapeRunManager.tsx; packages/dashboard/components/ScrapeRunManager.test.tsx; packages/dashboard/app/models/[id]/scraping/page.tsx; packages/dashboard/app/models/[id]/scraping/page.test.tsx. Add no unrelated files.
PASS_CRITERIA:
1. Preserve org/model/egress and kill-switch boundaries; no direct fallback, provider call, credential, raw HTML, raw provider payload or internal error is exposed.
2. Project persisted scrape results at an authenticated API/UI boundary into a bounded, typed, secret-safe view. Never render the current Raw research response details block. Keep public profile URLs only when the existing contract explicitly permits them; redact or omit all other unbounded fields.
3. Make completed, partial, failed, empty, queued/running and retry/unavailable states truthful. An all-failed or empty run must never render as successful research. Preserve observed zero versus unavailable and per-target failure details without echoing sensitive payloads.
4. Reuse the existing scraper-quality contract instead of creating a second result model; if a missing field cannot be supported by the current JSON/DB contract, return terminal BLOCKED naming the exact conflict rather than inventing a migration.
5. Add behavior tests for positive social/competitor projection, partial and all-failed states, empty/invalid result, bounded field/string/item counts, tenant/model authorization, no raw provider payload/secrets, and retry/unavailable rendering.
6. Run the owning API, worker and dashboard focused tests plus typecheck/build/lint where available; record exact commands and real exit codes.
7. DELIVERY must list SOURCE_REF, COPY_ROOT, changed paths, per-file SHA-256, behavior-test names/counts, exact command exits, and LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE. State explicitly that no deployment, installer, database, migration, provider, OAuth, credential, permission, network, systemd, service, commit or push action occurred.
BOUNDARY: LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE. DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, bridge service, deployment, live or disposable database, migrations or migration execution, provider calls, OAuth, credentials, permissions, systemd, network, runtime services, commit, push, generated output, or files outside COPY_ROOT. Do not use dates, clocks or filesystem timestamps for coordination.
HANDOFF: Codex audits and integrates only a hash-verified terminal delivery, runs the owning gates, commits and pushes the reviewed milestone. ACK/REPLIED is transport only and is not implementation delivery. Every reply must use the strict protocol and end exactly with:
sincerely, Codex
